test_worker_healthcheck: test the worker healthcheck endpoint by polling /healthcheck and verifying a 200 status with 'ok' in the response
poll_endpoint: poll an API endpoint with retry logic until the expected HTTP status code is received
get_request: send an HTTP GET request to a relative URL on the specified server URL
post_request: send an HTTP POST request with JSON payload to a relative URL on the specified server URL
post_refresh: post a webhook refresh event for a dataset to trigger a background update
